items.text: I just spoke to Dr Susan Ehrlich at @ZSFGCare and @SF_DPH about the rise of COVID cases & impact on our hospitals. Most cases are mild & don't require hospitalization. If you have normal cold/flu symptoms stay home! Seek medical help for serious symptoms, like trouble breathing.
Other serious symptoms to look out for are chest pain/pressure, confusion, an inability to sleep or wake, and pale/gray/blue skin tone. For more info, go to https://t.co/XX7lmRv2mB

I have tested positive for COVID-19 and am experiencing mild, cold-like symptoms. I’m thankful to be vaccinated and double boosted.

It's #SuicidePreventionMonth, a good time to remember the new @988Lifeline is not just for those in mental health crisis. It's also for friends & family seeking help. If someone you know says things like, “I wish I wasn’t here” or “Nothing matters,” call or text 988 for guidance. https://t.co/tyij4LN5R7

As MILPERS Chair I'm horrified by the troubling spike in servicemembers dying by suicide. I'm back in Alaska this #SuicidePreventionMonth w/servicemembers, their families & mental health providers to get to the bottom of this national crisis & ensure they know they're #NotAlone.

Seaman Danyelle Luckey was only 23 & embarking on her dream of serving her country when she was killed by gross medical negligence, preventable w/simple antibiotics. In her honor, @RepDeSaulnier & I are working to extend servicemember medical malpractice rights to ship clinics.

It’s the very least we can do for the brave women & men willing to put their lives on the line for our freedoms. You can read more about the Seaman Danyelle Luckey Military Medical Accountability Amendment Act on my website: https://t.co/EF3TvKEnoT
